storyboard.concept: Premium ruby elegance that speaks without words

scenes.visual: Ruby necklace set elegantly displayed in an open palm, the deep red stones catching light against diamonds
scenes.background: soft cream marble surface with gentle natural light from above, warm golden hour glow, subtle shadows creating depth
scenes.vo: Kuch cheezein sirf dikhti nahi, mehsoos hoti hain - ruby ki royal elegance

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of the ruby pendant's center stone, showcasing the intricate diamond halo and craftsmanship details
scenes.background: soft focus velvet texture in deep charcoal, dramatic side lighting creating sparkle and depth
scenes.vo: Har ruby stone mein chhupa hai perfect craftsmanship

scenes.visual: Complete ruby necklace and earring set artfully arranged, showing the matching design elements and coordinated beauty
scenes.background: pristine white silk with soft diffused lighting, creating an airy luxury feel with minimal shadows
scenes.vo: Premium ruby collection - apna style statement banayiye

storyboard.notes: Premium showcase focusing on the inherent beauty of the ruby set. Clean, minimal approach letting the jewelry speak through elegant framing and subtle camera movement. Warm Hinglish VO emphasizes the emotional connection and craftsmanship without making unsupported claims.
